title: StateShift: Tracking State-Dependent Reasoning Recovery Across Post-Training
target_track: Datasets and Benchmarks Track (Primary) / Main Track (Alternative)
subject_areas: Datasets and Benchmarks: LLM Evaluation and Benchmarking
Reinforcement Learning: Post-Training and Reasoning Dynamics
Trustworthy AI: Agent Reliability and Robustness
abstract: Standard evaluations of reinforcement-learning post-training in large language models emphasize aggregate benchmark accuracy, potentially obscuring behavioral changes conditional on local reasoning states. We introduce StateShift, a controlled evaluation framework and benchmark protocol for measuring target-transition recovery under matched counterfactual reasoning states...
